observations: Three photos show a used automotive steering rack assembly lying on a concrete floor.
The rack has a black rubber boot covering the central shaft, with visible wear and some cracking.
There are hydraulic lines and fittings attached to the top, including a small pressure gauge and a metal reservoir or valve block.
The ends of the rack have tie rod ends, one of which appears to be missing or detached.
The metal body of the rack shows signs of rust and dirt, especially near the fittings.
A watermark 'U-ZION LINKS AUTO'S' is visible on all photos.
No brand or model markings are visible on the rack itself in any photo.

proof_requests: A close-up photo of any part number or model marking on the steering rack.
A video showing the rack being moved through its full range of motion to check for leaks or binding.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a steering rack, but without model or part number, compatibility and value are uncertain. Internal condition and tie rod end wear cannot be assessed from current photos, which are critical for pricing. Proof is needed to determine the worst-case condition and compatibility.
